chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Whoever targets Allah as a goal (or mark) for quarrels, he will soon make much transition (from truth to falsehood).

key_terms.أَوْشَكَ: he will soon, or is likely to
key_terms.الِانْتِقَالَ: transition, change, or moving (from one state to another)
key_terms.نَصَبَ: to set up, place, or target

ai.seo_question: What happens to a person who makes Allah the target of their quarrels?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith to illustrate how trivializing divine matters for the sake of worldly or ego-driven disputes leads to spiritual instability. The phrase 'make Allah a target' (nasaba Allaha gharadan) signifies treating God as a mere instrument in human arguments, which risks causing the individual to rapidly shift from truth to falsehood (al-intiqal) as their focus shifts from divine reality to personal victory. This serves as a caution against *khushub* (stubbornness) in theological debates, emphasizing that the intent behind the dispute determines its spiritual consequence.
